card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

mechanism: A hands an incoming president the unwanted cleaning duty by invoking the recorded cost-saving rule that person proposed.
confusable: Unlike opportunistic delegation, A must demonstrate the office and existing decision make the task B's.
comparison: A leadership transition activates B's policy, unlike the bin scene's temporary personal swap.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
